summary: DRA_BIPOWER_JUMPINESS_BRANCH_CLOSE. The exact 52,608-row pre-2025 sealed H1 corpus, feature-specific primary prior, frozen declarative runner, unchanged DRA V1 parent parity, decision-time accounting and equal-capital assumptions passed. The primary realized-to-bipower-variation admission reduced Design drawdown from 29.530448% to 12.646094% and shortened median/P90 holding from 126.0/1818.6h to 119.0/1187.8h, but Design total PnL fell from 90.77797326 to 76.55009457 USDT. It failed more decisively in historical Validation: total and realized PnL fell from 86.20298186/89.41118307 to 74.76199737/74.76199737 USDT, drawdown rose from 7.121498% to 14.443056%, P90 holding rose from 1418.3h to 3499.8h, annual total-PnL breadth was 1/5 and the sole positive annual delta contributed 100% of positive uplift. Both frozen neighbors also lost Validation total PnL. This historical development feature family is closed without tuning, candidate creation or OOS access.

uncertainty: Historical Validation is post-hoc development evidence and not clean OOS; the study cannot establish independent alpha or a strategy candidate.
Hourly realized-to-bipower variation is a coarse jumpiness proxy, not a formal finite-sample jump test; changing sampling or estimator after this result is forbidden.
The primary reduced Design drawdown but materially worsened Validation total PnL and drawdown, so the Design path improvement cannot be interpreted as generalizable risk-adjusted value.
No post-2024, prospective, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE evidence was opened or created.
